title.purpose: Schedule periods and compact object labels.

shadows.name: notification-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the always-on-top notification from the Windows desktop.

shadows.name: object-shadow
shadows.purpose: Gives the authored inhaler a physical presence in the settings rail.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the switch knob from its track.

motion.name: notification-enter
motion.purpose: Short upward arrival for the reminder.

motion.name: notification-leave
motion.purpose: Fast downward dismissal after an action.

components.name: Primary Reminder Button
components.description: Confirms inhaler use in the notification.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 33px; padding: 0 10px; color: #fff9ef; background: var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); border: 1px solid var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); border-radius: 6px; font: 650 10.5px/1.3 "Manrope Local", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 130ms ease-out, border-color 130ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink, #28251f); border-color: var(--ink, #28251f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Reminder Button
components.description: Defers the reminder without competing with confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 33px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--ink, #28251f); background: var(--control-surface, #fffdf7); border: 1px solid var(--notification-line, #b8afa2); border-radius: 6px; font: 650 10.5px/1.3 "Manrope Local", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 130ms ease-out, border-color 130ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eee8de; border-color: #8f867a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Time Field
components.description: Keeps schedule measurement native, compact, and keyboard accessible.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; width: 96px; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; color: var(--muted, #6f685e); font: 500 10px/1.25 "Manrope Local", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 5px; color: var(--ink, #28251f); background: var(--control-surface, #fffdf7); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #aea598); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 11px/1.3 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #8e8578; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Schedule Switch
components.description: Shows enabled state with both position and clay color.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 34px; height: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-switch span { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #a8a094; transition: background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-switch span::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper-high, #fbf8f0); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(40, 37, 31, 0.26); transition: transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-switch input:checked + span { background: var(--clay, #c45f42); } .ds-switch input:checked + span::before { transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dose Chip
components.description: Names the reminder window in a terse measurement voice.
components.css: .ds-dose-chip { color: var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); font: 700 9px/1.3 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.055em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-dose-chip[data-period="evening"] { color: var(--sage, #61705c); }

components.name: Ruled Schedule Row
components.description: Groups one reminder window without introducing a card shell.
components.css: .ds-schedule-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(66px, .72fr) minmax(144px, 1.55fr) 34px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 58px; padding: 6px 0; color: var(--ink, #28251f); border-block: 1px solid var(--line, #c8c0b4); font-family: "Manrope Local", sans-serif; } .ds-schedule-row div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-schedule-row strong { font-size: 13px; } .ds-schedule-row small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted, #6f685e); font-size: 10px; } .ds-schedule-row > span { color: var(--ink, #28251f); font: 400 11px/1.3 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-schedule-row b { color: var(--clay, #c45f42); font-size: 18px; text-align: center; }

components.name: Notification Container
components.description: Joins the charcoal object bay and paper message field into the always-on-top reminder.
components.html:
Morning doseTime for your inhaler

Your scheduled reminder is ready.
components.css: .ds-notification { display: grid; width: 360px; min-height: 210px; grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0, 1fr); overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #28251f); background: var(--paper-high, #fbf8f0); border: 1px solid var(--notification-line, #b8afa2); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(37, 31, 24, .28), 0 4px 12px rgba(37, 31, 24, .16); font-family: "Manrope Local", sans-serif; transition: opacity 220ms ease-out, transform 250ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-notification:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-notification:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-notification-bay { padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--rail-accent, #ed7957); background: var(--ink, #28251f); } .ds-notification-bay svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; } .ds-notification-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 14px 15px; } .ds-notification-copy small { color: var(--clay-dark, #8f432f); font: 700 9px/1.3 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .055em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-notification-copy strong { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -.015em; } .ds-notification-copy p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #6f685e); font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.4; }

narrative.overview:
Breath Console makes a twice-daily health routine feel like a calm, dependable instrument. Both local Electron surfaces belong to one authored world: a warm paper workspace is anchored by charcoal equipment bays, quiet rules, and a single inhaler object rather than generic healthcare decoration.

The system is compact, tactile, and operational. It uses clay for intentional action, sage for confirmation, and restrained motion only to clarify state. The settings ledger moves from schedule to notification behavior to preferences and then recedes to the tray; the notification identifies the dose, presents the reminder, and offers confirm or defer without demanding navigation. The redesign preserves the existing element IDs, actions, localization, IPC behavior, and native control semantics.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper fields anchored by charcoal equipment bays.
Clay is action, sage is confirmation, and thin rules organize content.
Manrope drives the interface; monospace is reserved for measurements and small equipment metadata.
One authored inhaler illustration links settings and notification.

rules.name: The Instrument Signal Rule
rules.body: Clay means action, sage means confirmation or quiet state, and neither becomes a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for time, dose, and machine-like metadata; prose and actions stay in Manrope.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Routine settings stay flat and ruled; substantial shadow is reserved for the interruptive notification and the shared physical inhaler object.

dos: Do treat settings and notification as one local Windows product with the same paper, equipment bay, typography, and inhaler object.
Do keep schedule, notification behavior, preferences, and tray behavior in that operational order.
Do preserve native controls, visible focus, disabled states, reduced-motion behavior, localization fit, and every existing element ID and action.
Do use thin rules and tonal paper changes to organize routine content.
donts: Don't introduce teal glassmorphism, purple gradients, translucent panels, or stacked generic healthcare cards.
Don't turn clay or sage into broad decorative backgrounds; they are operational signals.
Don't add decorative dashboard modules, cloud/account patterns, or medical efficacy claims.
Don't substitute stock medical imagery, emoji, or multiple illustrations for the single authored inhaler object.
